name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
description: A composite of challenging evaluations covering reasoning, science, coding, and long-horizon work. Uses the highlighted model set on the public page; the full model dataset requires an API key.
note: Composite index. Includes several benchmarks that also appear separately on this site; it is counted once in the overall score. The public highlighted set can change as models are added.

costMethodology.note: Usage-based weighted cost per Intelligence Index task, including caching, reasoning and fallback models. The audited v4.3.2 task counts and weights are version-guarded; unknown versions are not estimated.

name: LiveBench 2.0
description: Contamination-free long-horizon tasks across coding, agentic work, reasoning, browser use, research, and design.
note: The overall score is the weighted category score published by LiveBench. Category tabs use the underlying category scores.

costMethodology.note: Release-matched cost.csv: total model-under-test spend divided by task count, including failures. Excludes fixed starting state and harness helper calls. Category costs use their own tasks.

name: LMArena Text Arena
description: Blind human preference votes on open-ended chat prompts. The score is an Elo-style rating.

costMethodology.note: Cost/Task (P50) is a median, not a mean. P50 is available only in single-benchmark views and is never pooled with means. API Price $/M is never substituted.

name: SWE-bench Pro V2
description: Long-horizon software engineering tasks in real repositories, graded by hidden tests.
note: Results are model + coding harness. The best reported harness is used and shown in the model detail.

costMethodology.note: No monetary cost per task matched to the current leaderboard runs was found in the public page payload. Cost limits are not actual spend and are not used.

name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
description: End-to-end terminal tasks completed by an autonomous agent in a sandbox.
note: Results are model + agent. The best reported agent is used and shown in the model detail.

costMethodology.note: API total_cost_usd divided by n_trials, including failures and repeated tasks. The website's Cost column is total spend, not cost per unique task.

name: Humanity's Last Exam
description: Expert-written questions across mathematics, science, humanities, and other fields.
note: Scaled independently by Scale AI, with confidence intervals where published.

costMethodology.note: No matching task cost is published in the inspected Scale leaderboard payload. Costs from Artificial Analysis's different HLE runs are not borrowed.

name: GSO
description: Software optimization tasks measuring whether agents can make real code faster.
note: Best reported OpenHands run is used.

costMethodology.note: The public leaderboard and compute_metrics.json publish scores, median runtime and turns, but no monetary task cost. Runtime and turns are not converted to dollars.

name: ARC-AGI-3
description: Interactive, novel problem-solving environments designed to test adaptation and agentic reasoning.
note: Semi-private v3 results. Provider-adapter runs and native runs are both considered; the best reported result is shown.

costMethodology.note: The v3 cost field is total run spend. Per-run attempt counts and completeness are not in the feed, and some runs are incomplete; totals are retained but not mislabeled $/task.

name: Code Arena — WebDev
description: Blind human preference votes on frontend and full-stack coding tasks.

costMethodology.note: Reported Cost/Task (P50), a median kept separate from benchmark means. P50 is available only in single-benchmark views; API Price $/M is never substituted.

name: MCP Atlas
description: Agentic evaluation of tool use through the Model Context Protocol, built by Scale AI.

costMethodology.note: The inspected public leaderboard payload does not publish monetary cost per task for its scored runs. Missing costs remain unknown.

name: CursorBench 4.0
description: Ambiguous, multi-file coding tasks drawn from real Cursor sessions, evaluated inside Cursor's agent harness.
note: Private, vendor-run benchmark. Only version 4.0 is used; results measure model + Cursor harness + reasoning effort. The best reported effort is selected, with its matching cost. Small score differences may not be statistically meaningful.

costMethodology.note: Published average cost per task, estimated by Cursor from observed input, cache-read, cache-write and output token usage at published prices. Paired with the exact score and effort; not an invoice or all-in operating cost.

name: τ³-Banking
description: Conversational banking tasks requiring policy compliance, multi-step tools and retrieval over a large company knowledge base.
note: Standard text submissions only: τ-bench v1.0.1, AllTools retrieval, GPT-5.2 user simulator, unmodified prompts and no omitted questions. Uses pass^1, not pass^4 or an average of domains. Other retrieval setups, custom agents and voice results are excluded.

costMethodology.note: No audited monetary mean task cost for this cohort. Numeric submission cost fields with unverified units/statistics are kept only in raw audit data; no inference from budgets or token pricing.

name: FrontierMath Tiers 1–3 v2
description: Expert-written mathematics problems from advanced undergraduate to research level, solved with access to a Python tool and objectively graded.
note: Epoch AI's successful private Tiers 1–3 v2 runs (task version 2.0.0) only. Earlier datasets, Tier 4, public examples and unsuccessful runs are excluded. Best reported effort is selected. FrontierMath was developed with OpenAI funding; Epoch discloses exclusive OpenAI access to a subset.

costMethodology.note: The official run CSV has no monetary task costs. Token counts and model training compute costs are not converted into evaluation spend.
